lines: The Taimanin guarding Gosha surrounded the strange old man and the ninja.
However, one of them stiffened his face in surprise and exclaimed,
Taimanin 1
「h?!! I-It can't be――Are you Tekkain Bantetsu?!」
Taimanin 1
「The close associate of Fuuma Danjou, who disappeared after the revolt―――」
Tekkain Bantetsu
「Oh? I'm most impressed. So even among the common ranks, there are those who know of me.」
Bantetsu laughed loudly, and lightly tapped the ground with his cane. At which point――
Gusha!!!
Taimanin 2
「Agaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaahhhhhhh?!!」
Taimanin 1
Making a bizarre sound, the body of one of the Taimanin “burst” from the inside.
Taimanin 1
「He used an Art on him?! Scatter!!!」
The person who had expired fell over with a thud.
At the same time, having sensed a threat, one Taimanin tried to take a distance from the old man, but――
Taimanin 1
「Guuuh?!」
Taimanin 1
（Wh-What?! This isn't...... What's the meaning of this?!!）
A strange feeling――It was like his torso and limbs were tightly bound.
Not just him, but all of the ten or so Taimanin who were surrounding the old man.
Unable to move their bodies, they flailed their limbs awkwardly on the spot.
Among them, there were some who were unable to keep their balance, and tumbled to the ground, still rigid.
Bantetsu
「Now, question time. How many of Gosha's troops have been mobilized?」
Taimanin 3
「D-Defeated Fuuma dog!!! Go to hell!!」
Bantetsu

「Hyo hyo♪ Most spirited. Young people do have to be, don't they?
――Here!」
Bantetsu tapped his cane on the ground.
Gucha!!!!
Taimanin 3
「Gahah?! Ah, gaah......」
Taimanin 1
The stomach of the Taimanin who had insulted him caved in massively, and his blood and organs burst out from his mouth.
Bantetsu
「Now, next. Is there anybody who will answer?」
Taimanin
Silence――
Despite having their comrade's gruesome death in front of their eyes, the Gosha Taimanin kept their mouths shut.
Bantetsu
「Hmm? This is why I hate young people these days. No respect for their elders.」
Ton, ton, ton.
Taimanin

「Agah?!」
「Huh?!」「Hiiih?!」
「Gyaaaaaaaaaaaahhhh!!」
Every time Bantetsu tapped his cane, the Taimanin's bodies burst, or their heads flew off.
Bantetsu
「Well, if they knew I was here, they wouldn't send common soldiers like these, would they?」
Bantetsu
「In which case, I can enjoy myself a little longer, yes? Good. Most sorry to detain you.」
Ton.
Gusha!!!!!
The torso of the last remaining Taimanin was twisted in two, and the area fell silent.
Bantetsu
「Now, let us go and continue the hunt. Follow me.」
Ninja
「............As you command.」
Accompanied by the ninja, who dripped with cold sweat, Bantetsu headed into the mountains.
Meanwhile, at that time――
Kotarou
「U-Um...... First I'll cleanse the wound. Tell me if it feels like it's stinging, Amane-san.」
Amane
Kotarou cleaned off the mud and filth with the water of the mountain stream, applied styptic and disinfectant, and wrapped her in bandages.
His manner of speaking had been hesitant, yet there was no hesitation in the way he used his hands.
Amane
（But... How should I put it......? I'm surprised......）
With mixed feelings, Amane looked sidelong at the face of the boy who was zealously treating her wounds.
He had bandaged her abdominal wound with his hands too, and now he was tending to her right foot.
Kotarou
『――I have an idea!!』
Under the guidance of Kotarou, who had said that forcefully, Amane had made her way to this place.
Using a forgotten secret passage in the hidden mansion's basement, which led into the mountains behind it.
Kotarou
『I found it by chance when I was looking for books in the library.』
Kotarou
『It looks like this mansion has been used by generations of Fuuma heads, so I'm guessing it was in preparation for an emergency――』
There was no point in having their emergency preparations widely known.
In all probability, only Danjou had known in his generation, and of course, Amane hadn't known of its existence either.

By going through that secret underground passage, the two of them had been able to successfully escape to this mountain stream, without the rogue ninja who surrounded the hidden mansion suspecting anything.
Amane
Amane
（And, this first-aid treatment......）
When they snuck out of the mansion, Kotarou had been carrying some kind of large piece of luggage.
She had felt suspicious, but...... after they got to the mountain stream, what he had taken out of it was a first-aid kit to treat her wounds.
Kotarou
『I've only read about this in books, so I don't know if I can do it very well, though......』
Saying that apologetically, he had begun to treat Amane's wounds.
......He had excellent skill.
Amane
（You can't do this much just by 『reading about it in a book』......）
He must have picked this up by reading it while picturing a specific situation, and engraving it in his brain.
Undoubtedly anticipating a situation when he would get caught up in a fight, and have to treat somebody.
――“I've always been reading books. I was sure that would be more useful to me.”
The words the boy had muttered to her when she met him in the library and questioned him.
That wasn't any kind of evasion or excuse. It was the truth――
Amane
（This boy is the incapable “Diot”......?）
She knew that he was made fun of as such in Gosha.
But to Amane's eyes.
The boy, who carried on treating her wounds with a serious face, didn't seem “incapable” in the slightest.
Kotarou
「――All right!! Your foot is done with for now! Next, your――」
Kotarou
「Amane-san, is that arm......?」
Amane
「Yes, well――」
At the focus of the boy's gaze was Amane's left arm.
It was a cyborg left arm attached after she had defected to the UFS, which had the functionality to make maximal use of her Evil Eye power.
Amane
「......It was almost destroyed by their leader.」
The leader of the rogue ninja had an ability that one could even call the “natural enemy” of someone who had mechanized their body.
Consequently, Amane had temporarily deactivated her cyborg arm to avoid any further damage.
Amane
「Well, don't concern yourself. It's not something you can do anything about with first-aid.」
She staggered to her feet, and the boy looked up at her with a puzzled-looking face.
Kotarou
「Amane-san? Are we leaving already......?」
Amane
「Yes. So, this is as far as I go with you.」
Kotarou
「Eh?」
His expression froze.
Amane
「What are you surprised about? You and I have already taken different paths.」
Amane
「Plus, once they find out the mansion is empty, they'll come after us. If that happens, you'll die with me.」
Kotarou
「―――Amane-san intends to die alone, doesn't she?」
The boy said quietly, looking at Amane's face.
Amane
Kotarou
「Ever since the mansion, Amane-san had been talking under the assumption that she was going to die.」
Kotarou
「Even when you were fighting those ninja, you were being sort of careless――」
Kotarou
「......Did you come this far with me to get me away?」
The mountain stream was away from the rogue ninja's siege.
If they came this far, even Kotarou should be able to escape to a safe area on his own.
Kotarou
「You intended to make that...... your final resting place, didn't you......?」
Kotarou
「The hidden Fuuma mansion that my father and the clan members used to use......」
In search of a place to die,
She had escaped to the hidden mansion where traces of Danjou remained――
Amane
Amane stared back at the boy's eye, which looked straight at her.
However, she didn't make any reply.
Because it was like he said.
She had been Danjou's favourite disciple, and had served him, thinking of him as if he were her real father.
After his death, she had continued fighting to try and avenge him.
However, at some point, she had realized it.
No matter how much she fought, Danjou would not return.
“Then, why fight?”――
It was at that point.
She had found out about the treachery of the Rogue Ninja Faction, whom she had thought were like-minded.
No, perhaps the visions that they and Amane had were different from the start.
They had forgotten Danjou's ideals, and joined forces with a corrupt government for the sake of their own ambitions.
There was no reason to fight alongside people when they had degraded into a group ruled by their own selfish desires.
Amane had defected――and so become a fugitive.
Amane
「Hmph. Don't poke your nose too deeply into my affairs――I did say that, didn't I?」
Kotarou
「Amane-san?!!」
The boy made a sorrowful cry.
Turning her back on that, she went straight into the mountains.
Amane

「You get out of here, idiot.
.........And be well.」
